debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging. Set false in production to avoid excessive log volume.

log_dir.description: Directory where CloudKitty writes log files. Leave empty to log to stdout only.

transport_url.description: AMQP transport URL for oslo.messaging. Format: rabbit://user:pass@host:port/vhost

db_connection.description: SQLAlchemy connection string for the CloudKitty relational database.

db_max_pool_size.description: Maximum number of persistent database connections kept in the pool.

db_max_overflow.description: How many connections above max_pool_size are allowed before callers block.

keystone_public_url.description: Public Keystone endpoint returned in WWW-Authenticate headers for client token validation.

keystone_auth_url.description: Internal Keystone endpoint used by CloudKitty for service-to-service authentication.

keystone_project_domain_name.description: Domain name that contains the CloudKitty service project.

keystone_user_domain_name.description: Domain name that contains the CloudKitty service user.

keystone_project_name.description: OpenStack project that owns the CloudKitty service user (usually 'service').

keystone_username.description: OpenStack service user name for CloudKitty.

keystone_password.description: Password for the CloudKitty service user. Use a strong random value.

memcached_servers.description: Memcached servers used by Keystone middleware for token caching.

server.description: Memcached server address in host:port format

oslo_lock_path.description: Directory used by oslo.concurrency for file-based inter-process locking.

collector.description: Telemetry data source backend. Supported values: gnocchi, monasca, prometheus.

collect_scope_key.description: OpenStack resource attribute that identifies a billing scope. Typically project_id or domain_id.

metrics_conf.description: Absolute path to the YAML file that defines which metrics to collect and their rating parameters.

collect_period.description: Telemetry collection granularity in seconds. Must match the Gnocchi archive policy granularity or Prometheus scrape interval.

collect_window.description: Number of consecutive periods fetched per processing run. Increase temporarily to catch up after processor downtime.

fetcher_scope_attribute.description: Keystone role that a project must have assigned to be included in rating. Set to empty string to rate all projects unconditionally.

storage_backend.description: Backend where rated data is persisted. Supported: influxdb, v2_gnocchi, elasticsearch, opensearch.

storage_version.description: Storage API version. Use 2 for all current backends; v1 is legacy.

influxdb_host.description: Hostname or IP of the InfluxDB server. Only used when storage_backend = influxdb.

influxdb_port.description: InfluxDB HTTP API port. Only used when storage_backend = influxdb.

influxdb_database.description: InfluxDB database name where rated data is stored. Only used when storage_backend = influxdb.

influxdb_username.description: InfluxDB user with write access to the rated-data database. Only used when storage_backend = influxdb.

influxdb_password.description: Password for the InfluxDB user. Only used when storage_backend = influxdb.

gnocchi_endpoint.description: Explicit Gnocchi API URL. Leave empty to auto-discover from the Keystone service catalog. Only used when collector = gnocchi.

gnocchi_granularity.description: Gnocchi archive policy granularity in seconds. Must equal collect_period. Only used when collector = gnocchi.

orchestrator_max_workers.description: Number of parallel worker threads in the rating orchestrator. Scale with available CPUs and number of tenants.

tenant_fetcher_backend.description: Backend used to discover billable projects. Currently only keystone is supported.

rating_pipeline.description: Ordered list of rating modules applied to collected telemetry data. Each module is applied in sequence.

module.description: Rating module name, e.g. hashmap, noop, pyscripts
